name: Quantum Information and Computation
description: Bits and qubits: physical and mathematical descriptions, classical computing and quantum computing overview, entanglement and non-locality in quantum mechanics, quantum gates and quantum circuits and their comparison with classical gates and classical circuits, projective measurements, teleportation, superdense coding, density matrices, quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution protocols, universality of gates in classical and quantum computing, Gottesman-Knill theorem, Solovay-Kitaev theorem, quantum oracles, quantum algorithms and circuit complexity (Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm, Simon’s problem, quantum Fourier transform, quantum phase estimation, Shor’s algorithm, Grover’s search algorithm and amplitude amplification), quantum error correction, physical and logical qubits, fault tolerant quantum computation, current status of quantum computers.
